# Email for notification type hosted_minutes (notifications.TypeHostedMinutes): refactor plan step S10.
# Regenerate (a deliberate, release-noted behavior change only):
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/notify -count=1 -run '^TestNotificationContent$'
# Emailed by default (OPENV_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_TYPES unset): yes. The override run sets it to exactly the
# types the defaults leave out. Each message is the SMTP hand-off of the real mailer;
# every line ends CRLF on the wire (a bare LF would show as ␊, a bare CR as ␍).

======== a lease takes the month's cloud runner minutes past 80% of the allowance | delivery 1 of 2 | to user-ada
with the default allow-list: sent; with the override: not sent
envelope: smtp.example.test:587, MAIL FROM openv@example.test, RCPT TO ada@example.test, no auth
-------- message
From: openv@example.test
To: ada@example.test
Subject: Cloud runner minutes nearly used up
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

Cloud runner minutes nearly used up

This month's leased cloud runner time has reached 510 of the 600 minutes the workspace's plan allows (80%).

Open it in OpenV:
https://openv.example.test/projects

—
You are receiving this because email notifications are enabled for your OpenV account. Turn them off in Settings → Notifications.
-------- end

======== a lease uses up the month's cloud runner minutes | delivery 1 of 2 | to user-ada
with the default allow-list: sent; with the override: not sent
envelope: smtp.example.test:587, MAIL FROM openv@example.test, RCPT TO ada@example.test, no auth
-------- message
From: openv@example.test
To: ada@example.test
Subject: Cloud runner minutes used up
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

Cloud runner minutes used up

This month's leased cloud runner time has reached 600 of the 600 minutes the workspace's plan allows. No more cloud runners can be leased until next month; agents on your own machine through the Agent Connector are not affected. A workspace admin can raise the allowance from the Billing tab.

Open it in OpenV:
https://openv.example.test/projects

—
You are receiving this because email notifications are enabled for your OpenV account. Turn them off in Settings → Notifications.
-------- end
